column1: # c-imagine F2V 2.0 visual item manifest (v2, measured surface)
#   - host must be a SIMPLE vanilla item (its 26.3 items/ def is a plain
#     minecraft:model ref) — the generated pack wraps the host def in a
#     range_dispatch (float rows) or select (select:<string> rows) with the
#     vanilla look preserved as the fallback branch.
#   - float rows: CMD floats ride custom_model_data.floats (index 0).
#   - cmd blank => auto-assigned 1000 + index in sorted-id order.
#     Auto-assignment is STABLE (sorted ids) across rebuilds.
#   - only rows listed here enter the pack (manifest-driven, no auto sweep —
#     real mod jars carry JEI-scale asset trees).
